mapper.sql: CASE LOWER(hpr.risk_level) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' THEN hpr.host_id END) AS risky_host_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' THEN 1 END) AS total_risk_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND LOWER(hpr.risk_level) = 'critical' THEN 1 END) AS critical_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND LOWER(hpr.risk_level) = 'high' THEN 1 END) AS high_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND LOWER(hpr.risk_level) = 'medium' THEN 1 END) AS medium_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND LOWER(hpr.risk_level) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS low_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND hps.pending_reboot = 1 THEN hpr.host_id END) AS pending_reboot_host_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND hpr.risk_type = 'missing_patch' THEN hpr.host_id END) AS missing_patch_host_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND hpr.risk_type = 'bad_patch' THEN hpr.host_id END) AS bad_patch_host_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND hpr.risk_type = 'patch_install_failure' THEN hpr.host_id END) AS install_failure_host_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hpr.status = 'open' AND hpr.risk_type = 'eol' THEN hpr.host_id END) AS eol_host_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hosts h LEFT JOIN host_patch_status s ON s.host_id = h.id AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.host_id IS NULL) AS unscanned_host_count, MAX(hpr.scan_time) AS latest_scan_time FROM host_patch_risk hpr LEFT JOIN host_patch_status hps ON hps.host_id = hpr.host_id AND hps.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE hpr.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT h.id AS host_id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, hps.os_build, h.status AS host_status, CASE MAX() WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'unknown' END AS highest_risk_level, COUNT(hpr.id) AS risk_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT hpr.risk_type ORDER BY hpr.risk_type SEPARATOR ',') AS risk_types, MAX(COALESCE(hps.pending_reboot, 0)) AS pending_reboot, MAX(COALESCE(hps.scan_time, hpr.scan_time)) AS last_patch_scan_time FROM host_patch_risk hpr INNER JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hpr.host_id LEFT JOIN host_patch_status hps ON hps.host_id = h.id AND hps.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
GROUP BY h.id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, hps.os_build, h.status ORDER BY MAX() DESC, COUNT(hpr.id) DESC, MAX(hpr.scan_time) DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT h.id FROM host_patch_risk hpr INNER JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hpr.host_id LEFT JOIN host_patch_status hps ON hps.host_id = h.id AND hps.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
GROUP BY h.id ) t

SELECT id, host_id, risk_id, risk_type, risk_name, risk_level, related_patch_id, related_cve, evidence, recommendation, status, scan_time FROM host_patch_risk WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'open' ORDER BY CASE LOWER(risk_level) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, scan_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT id FROM hosts WHERE status = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC
